platform_versions: Codex clients whose documented behavior matches the 2026-08-17 sources
compatibility.refusal_rule: Unknown, stale, or incompatible behavior cannot support a version-dependent deterministic conclusion.

assertions: Global discovery chooses AGENTS.override.md before AGENTS.md and uses only the first non-empty file at that level.
Project discovery walks from the project root to the current working directory and selects at most one override, base, or configured fallback file per directory.
Project instruction files are concatenated root-to-current-directory and closer guidance appears later and overrides earlier guidance.
The combined project instruction size stops at project_doc_max_bytes, whose documented default is 32 KiB.
Configuration precedence is CLI overrides, trusted project config from root to current directory with closest winning, selected profile file, user config, system config, then built-in defaults.
Untrusted projects skip project-scoped .codex configuration layers.
A skill directory requires SKILL.md with name and description and may contain scripts, references, assets, and agents/openai.yaml.

Repository skills are scanned from .agents/skills in every directory from the current working directory to the repository root; user skills are under $HOME/.agents/skills and admin skills under /etc/codex/skills.
Duplicate skill names are not merged and both may appear in selectors.
Symlinked skill folders are followed while scanning.

The initial skill list includes name, description, and path and uses at most 2 percent of the model context or 8000 characters when the context window is unknown; descriptions may be shortened and skills may be omitted with a warning.

review.notes: Only assertions present in the cited official OpenAI documentation snapshot are materialized. Runtime selection and causality remain explicitly unsupported.
